profile.headline: Exuberant, passionate, pragmatic engineer
profile.summary: I seek to deliver elegantly designed solutions, seek out new challenges and new opportunities for       learning, and to demonstrate superior engineering through the use of open source technology.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Ruby on Rails, Postgres/PostgreSQL, Docker, Nomad, Instana

 - Tech lead on W2 initiative.
 - Architected automated W2 payroll including integration with external vendor.
 - Designed and implemented integration of US Gov't ONET Occupation data set into our system.
 - Tech lead and architect on multi-quarter Modular Labor Order Form project to overhaul the way companies use our service to post requests for talent.
 - Actively participated in guidance committee for the future of monolith
 - Mentored engineers

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Ruby on Rails, Mongodb, Docker, Golang, React, Redis, Lambda

- Maintained Ruby on Rails app serving API and Origin (customer's sites)
- Parallelized test suite to cut deploy time in half
- Launched fourth generation self serve billing plans for Pro and Business
- Added tracking of non-user git committers to increase enterprise MRR
- Technical Lead for second generation enterprise billing system, automating and capturing previously unbilled MRR
- Mentored engineers across multiple teams, improving the abilities of the whole organization
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Communication Protocols · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Backend Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: AWS (Lambda, CloudFormation, DynamoDB, RDS/Aurora, AppSync, ECS, SQS, SNS, VTL), NodeJS, MySQL, ColdFusion, Docker, MSSQL

- Developed serverless architecture for order handling (AWS)
- Converted email based (higher cost and error prone) ordering system to use APIs
- Wrote AppSync (GraphQL) resolvers to retrieve data from DynamoDB/Aurora Serverless RDS/MS SQL/HTTP using AWS Lambda (NodeJS), velocity template language (vtl), and pipeline resolvers using CloudFormation
- Used GraphQL to retrieve data in legacy ColdFusion codebase as part of modernization

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: golang, React/Redux, Sagas, NodeJS, Mongo, ColdFusion, AngularJS, MySQL, AWS         (Lambda, S3), Docker, docker-compose

- Developed React/Redux/Saga SPA for presenting data from flagship desktop app 'Studio'.
- Upgraded NodeJS version of various services due to security vulnerability
- Expanded Jira integration support to include on-prem ('Jira Server') instances
- Refactored shopping cart flow to improve MOFU
- Added A/B tests to identify account growth opportunities
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Communication Protocols · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Ruby, Python, Cassandra, Mesos, Ansible, AngularJS

- Worked as part of a cross-functional team to refactor datastore to Cassandra.
- Maintained and extended Crepe (Ruby) based API that powers JS UI.
- Contributed to Python/Kafka based backend event/stream processing system.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Communication Protocols · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: Ruby on Rails, Sinatra, JavaScript(jQuery, D3, AngularJS, React), MySQL, sqlite,     Docker, Cassandra

- Implemented 'Interactions', 'Crash Reporting', and 'Version Trends' features for Mobile product.
- Worked with Browser agent team to launch Browser Product (beta) for Fluent 2014.
- Worked in cross-product team to overhaul time series service for rpm.newrelic.com.
- Wrote Blog posts and attended conferences to promote New Relic's Mobile product.
- Independently developed internal tools to improve developer productivity.
    - Dashing widget for test server availability
    - Feature rollout monitoring for cross-org timeseries service refactoring project)
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Communication Protocols · Representational State Transfer (REST)

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Technologies: PHP, XML-RPC/SOAP, JavaScript (ExtJS, Sencha Touch), PhoneGap/Cordova,               ActionScript3, XML, XMPP

- Singularly responsible for rewriting subscription module for accounting, parts, and security.
- Wrote flash (Actionscript 3) based XMPP client with Javascript hooks to provide realtime interaction for webapp users.
- Performed as needed client system modifications; wrote scripts for collecting client statistics.
- Developed ExtJS/PHP webapp used at thousands of automotive dealerships.
- Developed cross platform mobile (iOS and Android) version of desktop webapp using Sencha Touch 2.
- Pioneered mobile device profiles to optimize layout on tablets

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies: C/C++, asn1c, PHP, wireshark/tcpdump, tcpreplay, Python

- Lead the development of the IM/Chat Surveillance Module, including MSN Messenger, Yahoo Messenger, ICQ, Twitter, and Paltalk Express.
- Lead the transition from CVS to SVN.
- Refactored provisioning application to remove duplicate code, improve readability and maintainability.
- Performed object-oriented design/analysis, software development, and requirements planning.
- Used Valgrind, gcov/lcov, and PMD to optimize existing code.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Network Protocols · Communication Protocols
